sources.title: GitHub - aymericzip/intlayer: Per-component Internationalisation ...
sources.snippet: Intlayer is a modern i18n solution for web and mobile apps. It's framework-agnostic, AI-powered, and includes a free CMS & visual editor. With per-locale content files, TypeScript autocompletion, tree-shakable dictionaries, and CI/CD integration, Intlayer makes internationalization faster, cleaner, and smarter.
